name: mitigation mechanism
definition: Harris's three-way distinction (2023): allocation assigns the risk to a named party by contract; spreading transfers it to third parties for a premium; pooling mutualises it among stakeholders with no outsider. The sort key of this census.

name: membership basis
definition: Ground on which a participant belongs to the pool.

name: entry restriction
definition: Membership is closed or numerically restricted (1 = restricted).

name: participation basis
definition: Whether participation is chosen or imposed. Theoretically loaded: if pooling raises each participant's time-average growth rate, compulsion demands an explanation, and the non-excludability of the pooled good is the usual one.

name: contribution timing
definition: When contributions fall due. ex-post-assessment is the general-average pattern (contribute after the loss); ex-ante is the fund pattern.

name: contribution basis
definition: How each member's contribution is measured.

name: contribution enforceability
definition: Non-payment can be compelled or sanctioned (1 = enforceable).

name: hazard correlation
definition: Correlation of the hazard across members, which sets the sign of the pooling. Idiosyncratic hazards diversify; covariate hazards synchronise and can make the pool worse than no pool.

name: hazard responsiveness
definition: The hazard responds to the defence mounted against it (1 = adversarial, e.g. an enemy fleet; 0 = indifferent, e.g. a storm).

name: pool output
definition: What the pool actually produces. collective-good: the fund buys something non-excludable for all members (convoy escort, city walls) and no individual draws on it. individual-indemnity: a member is compensated for a realised loss. individual-draw: a member receives the pot by rotation, lot or auction irrespective of loss. PY1-PY3 presuppose an individual payout and are inapplicable where PY0 is collective-good.

name: payout trigger
definition: What entitles a member to draw on the pool.

name: allocation rule
definition: How the draw is allocated among eligible members. Meaningful only where PY1 does not already determine it.

name: payout cap
definition: The draw is capped independently of the loss suffered (1 = capped).

name: loss-sharing rule
definition: How an unmet loss is distributed once the pool is exhausted or insufficient.

name: residual claim on fund
definition: Members hold a claim on the fund's surplus (1 = yes).

name: liability beyond contribution
definition: A member can be pursued beyond what he has contributed or agreed to contribute (1 = exposed, 0 = shielded). The participant-side barrier question, and the direct analogue of AP3 in organizational_forms. QUALIFIED 2026-08-18 (ii): AP3 was relocated to the labour-supplying party and restricted to the venture's third-party creditors, so 'the direct analogue of AP3' now holds only where this dataset's member is a single party facing outside creditors - the sea-loan family, where it is exact. Where a loss_mitigation form is a bilateral capital-labour contract the same locator defect would apply here, which is one reason LS3 is NOT coded for several named rows [withheld 2026-09-28: names a form under re-coding].

name: loss verification mode
definition: HOW a claimed loss is established - the MODE ONLY. Split from the object of verification on 2026-08-13; before that this characteristic silently asked two questions and the values below answer only the first. See VF2 for WHAT is established. Bears on whether the coupling can operate at all; candidate for promotion to outcome-coupling once forms separate it from PY1.

name: verification object
definition: WHAT is established before payment, as distinct from how. loss-occurrence: that the defined misfortune happened or persists. claimant-need: that the claimant has been reduced to want, irrespective of the event. claimant-fault: that the misfortune did not arise from the claimant's own misconduct. conduct-compliance: that the claimant is observing the conditions of relief while drawing it. mixed: two or more of these at once. Ontologically dependent on VF1 - an object of verification presupposes that verification occurs - so VF2 is .NA wherever VF1 is 'none'.

name: governance mode
definition: Locus of decision-making over the fund.

name: pool duration
definition: Intended life of the arrangement. A rotating association completes a cycle; a levy runs indefinitely.

name: terminal distribution
definition: What happens to the fund at dissolution. Meaningful only where DR1 is not open-ended.

name: peril-risk bearer
definition: Who bears loss from the peril itself - shipwreck, seizure, jettison. Paired with RB2, which asks the same question of loss from the market; the pair exists because the two need not fall on the same party.

name: market-risk bearer
definition: Who bears loss from price movement and failed sale, as distinct from loss to the peril itself (RB1).

name: security or pledge
definition: What secures the advance. VALUE SET WIDENED 2026-08-09 on the tanomoshi-ko evidence, which the original maritime set could not hold: 'cargo' renamed 'goods' so that movables in trade take one state whether at sea or in a warehouse (the at-peril question is RB4's, not this one); 'real-estate' added for land, town lots and storehouses; 'surety' split out of 'personal', which was doing duty both for security on the borrower's own estate and for a third party standing behind him - Kato 1998, 147 makes the suretyship mandatory BECAUSE foreclosure was slow in some jurisdictions, so the two are distinct facts; 'mixed' for arrangements taking property and surety together. WIDENED AGAIN 2026-08-16: 'freight' added, the naulum or nolo being pledged in its own right in three independent corpora; 'general-estate' added for a charge on the whole of the borrower's goods present and future, which is not the same fact as a named parcel of his own property. Does NOT cover a member pledging his claim ON a pool to secure borrowing OUTSIDE it (Matsunaga 1999, 297) - that is a second question and belongs to transferable claims in organizational_forms.

name: discharge on total loss
definition: The obligation is extinguished if the venture is lost (1 = discharged).

name: peril priced ex ante
definition: Whether the cost of bearing the peril is set before the event (1 = priced). Deliberately says PERIL, not risk: the characteristic measures the movement from a hazard conception (an event that may befall, no distribution, not priceable) to a risk conception (a quantified distribution, priceable, transferable to a party with no stake), so it cannot be named with the endpoint of the shift it measures. CODING RULE: a premium recovered by inference from a freight rate or an exchange rate is analyst-imposed, never articulated.
